run_mlinter_cli: run the mlinter CLI to check modeling structure files for TRF rule violations
analyze_file_trf_rules: analyze a Python modeling file against TRF lint rules and return a list of violations
get_changed_modeling_files: get modeling files changed compared to a base git ref for targeted linting
iter_modeling_files: iterate over modeling, modular, and configuration Python files in the models root
build_rule_checks: auto-discover and build TRF rule check functions from trf*.py modules in the mlinter package
